about: The world map: every place, its doors and where they lead, what the story knows about it. The build turns it into MAP in the page and NEXT, PLACES, LOCATIONS and WALK in the worker (source/world.mjs). kind: 'story' = a place the story can name (needs desc and actions), 'pass' = page only, walked through on the way (west blocks, the landing, the bathroom; actions here are the page's only, default walking and idle), 'vehicle' = bus and taxi. links: exit/entry = x where he leaves / appears ('R' = off the right edge, W+8); ride = by bus or taxi. next: extra places the story may name as the next stop that the doors alone don't give. walkMin: minutes to walk through or into it (default story 4, pass 1). rideOnly: reached only by bus or taxi and its links don't need a way back (offscreen). map: [column, row] on the director's map page (/map): row 0 is the street-level line from the promenade to Herzl east, floors of The Big S above, doors into buildings below. screens / of: a story place made of several page screens (The Big S: 'mall' is mall1a-2c); the place has no links, its screens do, each with of: the place; the page picks the screen and walks him there.

apartment.desc: his one-room flat: bed, desk with laptop and a small 49-key keyboard he plays badly, armchair, small kitchen with a sink, a broom, a closet, a bathroom door (the camera never sees inside; use bathroom/showering), window with Moshe the basil. When he is home alone with nothing on (action idle) the camera shows him doing ordinary things: sweeping, washing up, wiping the counter, folding laundry, playing the keyboard, lying on the bed or in the armchair with his phone, making a snack, coffee by the window, watering Moshe, a little dance. Say which in what happens
notes: front door, bathroom door
bathroom door -> apartment

corridor.desc: the building hallway outside his door
notes: apt 4 door, stairs (down to the street, or to the first floor)
first-floor landing (page only): stairs up, stairs down, apt 2's door

apt2.desc: Boaz's flat, apartment 2 on the first floor of Ishai's building (down one flight): old patterned floor tiles, a china cabinet, a fish tank, an old TV, a long dining table. Ishai only goes in when he is invited, on poker nights
notes: Boaz's front door

street.desc: Herzl Street outside his building (west end): Avi's falafel kiosk, a bus stop bench, the doors of Herzl Gym and The Black Candle bar, traffic. Going west, three more blocks of Herzl Street lead to the park: PicSell (pictures, posters, printed shirts), a pharmacy, the Soap Opera launderette, a barber, a makolet, a bakery, a second-hand bookshop and a bicycle shop. He only walks past those on his way to the park; he never stops in them
notes: building entrance (up to his floor, or to the first floor)
the same stop: the bus (or a taxi) to the promenade

park.desc: a small park at the west end of Herzl Street, a few blocks' walk from his building: a bench, a pond with one duck, a big tree. On its far (west) side stands the Pump House
notes: right edge -> the park end of Herzl St.; left edge -> the Pump House

plaza.desc: the plaza in front of the Pump House, an old red-brick water-pump hall on the far side of the park, now a small venue for concerts and art (walk through the park; no bus): its iron sign, double doors, a ticket window where Hagit sits, a poster board, rope lanes for queues, the park's trees at the edge. The board says it opens soon, with events on Wednesdays
notes: the park path on the right; the Pump House doors
left edge -> the promenade (prom1)

arena.desc: inside the Pump House hall: a stage under old pipes, a pixel screen, speaker stacks, a merch table, a concrete floor. Only open for its events; Ishai only goes in on an event night
notes: the hall's door, on the right
the promenade east (CAM-23, page only): right edge -> the Pump House plaza, left edge -> the promenade

promenade.desc: the promenade by the sea, west of the Pump House (walk through the park and past the Pump House, or the bus or taxi to its own stop): the wave-patterned walk, a white railing over the beach, palm trees, benches facing the walk, a lifeguard tower on the sand, joggers and cyclists, the sea; at its west end the big mall, The Big S
notes: the promenade (CAM-24, story place): right edge -> prom1 (the plaza), left edge -> prom3 (The Big S), its own bus stop (128) -> Herzl St. by bus or taxi
the promenade west (CAM-25, page only): right edge -> the promenade; The Big S's glass doors (52) -> its ground floor (mall1a)

mall.desc: The Big S, the big mall at the west end of the promenade (walk along the promenade, or the bus or taxi to the promenade's stop): floors 1 and 2, shops along tiled walkways, escalators in the middle, air conditioning. Shops: Yalla Yoga (sportswear), PicSell (posters and prints), Everything Else Express, FluffNap (bedding), Kfar Kofi (coffee), 8bit Games, Threadbare (clothes), Sole Mates (shoes), Toy Box, Pixel Phones, an optician, BRRR! (ice cream), Page Turner (books), a Tahini Tower Savings Bank branch. He browses ('idle'), buys, meets someone. Open 09:00-22:00, Friday until 16:00, closed on Saturday. The food court is upstairs (foodcourt)
notes: The Big S, floors 1-2 (story place made of six screens; the page picks the screen he goes to and walks him there)

foodcourt.desc: the food court on the top floor of The Big S, under a glass roof (up the escalators from the mall): counters of HummusPrime, Wok This Way, Pizza Pi, Salad Days, Schnitzel Schtick and Kfar Kofi around tables and chairs; he eats or drinks sitting at a table. Open 09:00-22:00, Friday until 16:00, closed on Saturday
notes: The Big S, floor 3 (story place made of two screens)
floor 1 west (CAM-30): the glass doors to the promenade (20), right edge -> mall1b
floor 1 middle (CAM-31): the escalator up (its foot at 166) -> floor 2
floor 1 east (CAM-32)
floor 2 west (CAM-33)
floor 2 middle (CAM-34): the escalator from floor 1 arrives at 40 (and goes back down there), the escalator up to the food court at 166
floor 2 east (CAM-35)
floor 3, the food court west (CAM-36): the escalator from floor 2 arrives at 40; right edge -> mall3b
floor 3, the food court east (CAM-37); right edge -> the PixelPlex lobby (its doorway)
the PixelPlex lobby (CAM-39, page only): left edge -> the food court east; the SCREEN door (170) -> the auditorium; the snack bar (popcorn, Cooola) where he goes at the intermission

cinema.desc: the PixelPlex, the cinema off the food court on the top floor of The Big S (up the escalators): red seats, a red curtain, the big screen. Only on Saturday nights, for the weekly film (planned moments only)
notes: the PixelPlex auditorium (CAM-38, story place, event only): the door on the left (8) -> the lobby's SCREEN door (170)
three blocks you walk through, on the way between the park and his building
left edge -> Herzl St. west, on the way to the park

shops.desc: the SIDEWALK of Herzl Street east, the next block toward the cafe (the camera only sees the sidewalk and the shop windows; he cannot be inside a shop here - shopping for electronics, clothes or home stuff happens at the Everything Else store - bus from the street to the market, then walk in): Herzl Hardware, the Tahini Tower Savings Bank with an ATM, a flower shop with buckets of flowers on the sidewalk, a pedestrian crossing with traffic lights, ficus trees; Cafe Nahat is on the corner at the end
notes: left edge -> street; the café door (186) -> Cafe Nahat; right edge -> Herzl east 1 (past the café)

cafe.desc: Cafe Nahat, a corner cafe (soft pop and soft rock on the radio, quietly)
notes: entrance door -> Herzl St. east
next: the story may send him from the café straight to the street (he walks back through the shops block)
Herzl east 1 (CAM-26, page only): the square with Stanley Cubrick; left edge -> shops, right edge -> east2
Herzl east 2 (CAM-27, page only): the mural (the Earth, squared) and Shmulik's kiosk (its counter at 140)
Herzl east 3 (CAM-28, page only): the fountain; left edge -> east2 (the street goes on, off camera)

kiosk.desc: Shmulik's kiosk on Herzl Street, two blocks past Cafe Nahat (walk east past the café, the little square with the brick statue Stanley Cubrick, to the mural): a street kiosk open 24 hours, every day; a counter open to the sidewalk, sweets and snacks on shelves, a drinks fridge, sunflower seeds in bins, newspapers, the MAZAL lottery stand, a radio, a white plastic table and chairs on the sidewalk. Shmulik is behind the counter 06:00-18:00 (a quiet night clerk otherwise); he plays backgammon over the counter with regulars
notes: Shmulik's kiosk (CAM-29, story place): he walks in from the left (the sidewalk) and leaves the same way

gym.desc: Herzl Gym, a small neighborhood gym on Herzl Street, two doors from his building: treadmills facing two wall screens, Channel 9 with the sound on and 8bitTV, NESflicks or RGBeat next to it, a mirror wall with dumbbells, a water cooler. Here "exercising" means he walks or jogs on the treadmill watching the TV. Open 06:00-23:00
notes: Herzl Gym door (blue building)
gym door -> street

bar.desc: The Black Candle, a small dark rock bar on Herzl Street next to his building: black brick, red neon, candles on the tables, band posters, a bearded bartender, rock and alternative music on the radio all night. He sits at a candle-lit table (drinking a beer, eating bar snacks). Opens 17:00, closes 02:00
notes: The Black Candle door (next to the bench)
bar door -> street

market.desc: Shuk Shalom, an open-air food market a short bus ride away (bus or taxi from the stop on Herzl Street; it has its own bus stop): stalls of tomatoes, cucumbers, oranges, bananas, spices, fresh pita, olives and fresh juice, vendors calling out prices, crowds. Food only. He can eat a snack or drink a fresh juice there. Open 07:00-19:00 (Friday until 14:00, closed on Shabbat). Its vendors also deliver through ateBite
notes: bus stop: the bus (or a taxi) to Shuk Shalom
the market's own bus stop; the store door on the left

store.desc: Everything Else, the big store next to Shuk Shalom (walk in from the market): everything except food - a wall of TVs and electronics, phones, clothes, kitchenware, lamps, cleaning stuff; a cashier at the checkout. He browses ("idle") or talks to a salesperson. Open 09:00-21:00 (Friday until 14:00, closed on Shabbat)
notes: store door -> market

campus.desc: Tel Herzl University, a bus ride away from Herzl Street (bus or taxi; it has its own stop): the courtyard, a vending machine, students. Ishai only goes there for his history lectures (planned)
notes: the same stop: the bus (or a taxi) to the university
the university's own bus stop; the lecture building's doors

classroom.desc: a lecture room at the university, only used during a lecture
notes: the lecture room's door, on the right

bus.desc: inside the city bus, line 88 (camera on board): he sits by the window with the city going past, a few other passengers around him
notes: on board: he gets off at a stop

taxi.desc: the back seat of a taxi (camera on board): the driver in front, the meter running, the city going past the window

offscreen.desc: anywhere without a camera (the supermarket, a client's office, a friend's home); he gets there by bus or taxi from the bus stop on Herzl Street and comes back the same way
notes: bus stop: bus or taxi
